invariantLines.necessity: For line P+R*v to contain H(P), (k-1)(P-O) lies in R*v; dividing by k-1 shows O is on the line.
invariantLines.sufficiency: O+t*v maps to O+k*t*v; k!=0 makes the parameter map onto R.

invariantPlanes.necessity: With O as origin, n dot x+d=0 maps to n dot x+k*d=0; n!=0 and equality of planes require (k-1)*d=0.
invariantPlanes.sufficiency: The plane O+span(u,v) maps onto itself because k!=0.

subcases.pointwiseVsSetwise: For nonidentity k, lines and planes through O are invariant as sets, but their only individually fixed point is O.

subcases.necessity: For any distinct A,B, A_image B_image=abs(k)*AB; distance preservation forces abs(k)=1.

subcases.construction: For each given vertex V!=O, take V_image on the opposite ray from OV with OV_image=2*OV; V=O remains O. Connect the six corresponding edges.

exercises.areaDerivation: Each triangular face has both base and altitude scaled by abs(k), so area and total surface area scale by k^2, not signed k and not k^3.

subcases.construction: Choose the supplied vertex O as center; trisect each segment from O to the other seven vertices, taking the first-third point; O stays fixed. Connect the twelve corresponding edges.
subcases.straightedgeCompassMethod: On an auxiliary ray from O mark three equal steps, join its third point to V, and through its first point draw a parallel to that join; its intersection with OV is V_image.
subcases.alternative: Trisect the three incident edges and complete parallel faces; the eight image vertices are O+(epsilon1*a+epsilon2*b+epsilon3*c)/3 for all epsilon in {0,1}^3.
subcases.generality: A general oblique parallelepiped is allowed; no rectangular or numeric specimen is assumed.

subcases.areaDerivation: Each parallelogram face has base and altitude scaled by 1/3, hence area by 1/9; summing six faces preserves that factor.
